summary: Frontend-only verification of 4 reported fixes on Intrinsic Technology marketing site. Tested at 1920x900 (CSS zoom active, body.style.zoom=1.4056), 1280x900 (no zoom), and 390x844. All reported issues are resolved.

home_security_diagram_visible.1920x900_zoom: clip-path=inset(0px), classes include lr-reveal-in, naturalWidth=927, visible after scroll
home_security_diagram_visible.1280x900_no_zoom: clip-path=none, naturalWidth=927, visible (never clipped - above-fold scan skipped)

verification_details.all_home_images_reveal: After scroll + safety sweep, zero main img.lr-reveal remain without lr-reveal-in at all 3 viewports

industry_hero_natural_height.industry-hero (retail): Page renders a 'Coming Soon' fallback — expected, no industry-hero testid, no bug

verification_details.industry_hero_image_reveal: All 5 industry sub-pages' first-section ended with class lr-reveal-in / img-reveal is-in, clip-path=inset(0px), opacity=1 at both viewports
verification_details.navigation_flash: Home -> Cybersecurity -> Industries -> non-profit -> Home: at 400ms after each nav, h1 and main content text (len>3000) already correct, no le-wait class, no flash of default content observed
verification_details.regression_home_and_cyber_hero: Both load with correct h1 at 1920 and 390 viewports; hero images present (reveal as expected on scroll)

critical_code_review_comments: ImageReveal 4s safety sweep is a good fallback but means images could briefly appear clipped for up to 4s under zoom if an edge case misses them; current scan() excludes above-fold images (top < innerHeight*0.9) so initial paint is fine.
LiveEditProvider.jsx is 366 lines and dense — consider splitting into hooks (useTheme, useBlocks, useEditsSync) for maintainability (>700 line threshold not hit, so advisory only).
firstPaintPending counter is a module-level let; a hot-reload or SSR context could leave it in a stale state. Low risk in CRA dev-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 reported issues verified fixed. /industries/retail intentionally renders a 'Coming Soon' fallback (no industry-hero testid); treat that as expected unless the spec changes. Always test both >1366 (zoom) and <=1366 widths because document.body.style.zoom only applies when viewport>1366 (ViewportScale in App.js).
